request.note: No payload. The handler reads no field.

responses.name: Success
responses.when: You have a character. **Server bug:** the reply goes out on the `players` event, not on a `pets` event. The array has the values of `player.p.pets`, or is empty. The shape of a pet record is unclear from the source: no live code writes `p.pets`.

confirm.live_needed: The items come from `player.p.pets`, which no live code writes; their shape (if any character has them) is only visible live.

responses.note: The `players` request replies on the same event with `PlayersEntry` objects. Tell the two replies apart by the request that you sent.

order: `players` (an array of pet records) to you
